entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and have at least 2 blank pages.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener al menos 6 meses de validez desde la llegada y al menos 2 páginas en blanco.
entry.quote: To enter Laos, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages.

entry.en: All foreign nationals must complete the Lao Digital Immigration Form online within 3 days before arrival and before departure.
entry.es: Todos los extranjeros deben llenar en línea el Formulario Digital de Inmigración de Laos dentro de los 3 días previos a la llegada y a la salida.
entry.quote: All foreign nationals entering Laos are required to complete the LDIF digitally within 3 days before arrival and 3 days before departure.

entry.en: Goods you can take into or out of Laos are strictly regulated, and you must declare anything that may be prohibited or taxable.
entry.es: Hay reglas estrictas sobre los bienes que puedes llevar a Laos o sacar de él, y debes declarar lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Laos. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

entry.en: As of September 1, 2025, all nationalities must fill out an online arrival form before entering Laos.
entry.es: Desde el 1 de septiembre de 2025, todas las nacionalidades deben llenar un formulario de llegada en línea antes de entrar a Laos.
entry.quote: As of September 1, 2025, all nationalities are required to fill out an online arrival form prior to entering Laos

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to Xaisomboun Province because of intermittent attacks on infrastructure and armed clashes with anti-government groups.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje no esencial a la provincia de Xaisomboun por ataques intermitentes a infraestructura y enfrentamientos armados con grupos antigubernamentales.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to Xaisomboun Province. There are intermittent attacks on infrastructure and armed clashes with anti-government groups.

safety.en: Travellers regularly report random bag snatches, often by people on motorcycles, so hold your bag away from the road and keep valuables out of sight.
safety.es: Los viajeros reportan con frecuencia arrebatos de bolsos, a menudo por personas en motocicleta; lleva el bolso del lado opuesto a la calle y no muestres objetos de valor.
safety.quote: Travellers regularly report random bag snatches, often by people on motorcycles. Hold your bags on the side away from the road, and do not have valuables on display.

safety.en: Do not leave your passport as a deposit when hiring motorcycles, as rental companies have reportedly arranged for bikes to be stolen or damaged and then kept passports and demanded high fees.
safety.es: No dejes tu pasaporte como depósito al rentar motocicletas; se ha reportado que algunas empresas hacen que las motos sean robadas o dañadas y luego retienen el pasaporte y exigen altas tarifas.
safety.quote: Do not leave your passport as a deposit or guarantee when hiring motorcycles. There have been reports of rental companies arranging for their motorcycles to be deliberately stolen or damaged, then keeping passports and demanding high fees.

safety.en: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness from alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Laos.
safety.es: En Laos ha habido muertes y casos graves de enfermedad por bebidas alcohólicas con metanol.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Laos.

safety.en: Landmines and other unexploded weapons are a hazard throughout Laos; keep to main routes in rural areas and do not pick up metal objects.
safety.es: Las minas y otras armas sin explotar son un peligro en todo Laos; en zonas rurales mantente en las rutas principales y no recojas objetos metálicos.
safety.quote: Landmines and other unexploded weapons are a hazard throughout Laos and kill a number of people each year. Keep to main routes in rural areas, and do not pick up metal objects.

safety.en: Laos has a zero-tolerance policy on drug offences.
safety.es: Laos tiene una política de tolerancia cero ante los delitos de drogas.
safety.quote: The Laos authorities have a zero-tolerance policy to drug offences.

health.en: Dengue and malaria are endemic in Laos, so take extra precautions against mosquito bites.
health.es: El dengue y la malaria son endémicos en Laos, así que extrema las precauciones contra las picaduras de mosquito.
health.quote: Dengue and malaria are endemic, so you should increase precautions to avoid being bitten by mosquitoes.

health.en: Tap water is not drinkable anywhere in Laos, but bottled water is cheap and widely available.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es potable en ningún lugar de Laos, pero el agua embotellada es barata y fácil de conseguir.
health.quote: Tap water is not drinkable anywhere in Laos, but bottled water is cheap and widely available.

health.en: Medical care in Laos can be basic and outside the capital there are no reliable facilities for medical emergencies.
health.es: La atención médica en Laos puede ser básica y fuera de la capital no hay instalaciones confiables para emergencias médicas.
health.quote: Medical care in Laos can be basic and outside the capital there are no reliable facilities to deal with medical emergencies.

health.en: Medical evacuation is difficult to organise and very expensive, so have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds.
health.es: La evacuación médica es difícil de organizar y muy cara, así que ten un seguro de viaje adecuado y fondos accesibles.
health.quote: Medical evacuation is difficult to organise and very expensive. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds to cover the cost of any medical treatment abroad and repatriation.

health.en: Anthrax has been found in cattle and buffalo near 4,000 Islands, Pakse and the Bolaven Plateau.
health.es: Se ha encontrado ántrax en ganado y búfalos cerca de las 4,000 Islas, Pakse y la meseta de Bolaven.
health.quote: Anthrax has been found in cattle and buffalo near the tourist areas of 4,000 Islands, Pakse and the Bolaven Plateau.

health.en: Regional air pollution can be a problem in Laos and may aggravate heart, lung or respiratory conditions.
health.es: La contaminación del aire regional puede ser un problema en Laos y agravar afecciones del corazón, pulmones o respiratorias.
health.quote: Regional air pollution can be a problem in Laos and may aggravate heart, lung or respiratory conditions.

help.en: Fire is 1190 and Police is 1191, with alternative police station numbers 241162, 241163, 241164 and 212703.
help.es: Bomberos: 1190 y Policía: 1191, con números alternativos de estaciones de policía 241162, 241163, 241164 y 212703.
help.quote:
Fire: 1190

Police: 1191

Alternative numbers for police stations: 241162, 241163, 241164, and 212703

help.en: The Tourist Police in Vientiane are on 021 251 128 and the ambulance is 1195 or 030 525 7239.
help.es: La Policía Turística en Vientiane es el 021 251 128 y la ambulancia el 1195 o 030 525 7239.
help.quote:
Tourist police in Vientiane: 021 251 128 

Ambulance: 1195 or 030 525 7239

help.en: Local law enforcement responses to crimes are often limited, so ask your accommodation staff for help reporting a crime.
help.es: La respuesta policial local a los delitos suele ser limitada, así que pide ayuda al personal de tu alojamiento para denunciar.
help.quote: Local law enforcement responses to crimes, even violent crimes, are often limited.

getting_in.en: Vientiane International Airport (VTE) is Laos' main airport, with flights to China, Vietnam, South Korea, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Yangon, Hong Kong, Singapore and Phnom Penh.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Vientiane (VTE) es el principal de Laos, con vuelos a China, Vietnam, Corea del Sur, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Yangon, Hong Kong, Singapur y Phnom Penh.
getting_in.quote: Laos' main airport has flights to/from various cities in China, Vietnam and South Korea, as well as Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Yangon, Hong Kong, Singapore and Phnom Penh.

getting_in.en: Luang Prabang International Airport (LPQ) has flights to and from Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Haikou, Hanoi and Siem Reap.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Luang Prabang (LPQ) tiene vuelos hacia y desde Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Haikou, Hanoi y Siem Reap.
getting_in.quote: Laos' second international airport has flights to/from Bangkok (both airports), Chiang Mai, Haikou, Hanoi and Siem Reap

getting_in.en: Pakse International Airport (PKZ) has Lao Airlines flights to and from Guangzhou, Siem Reap and Ho Chi Minh City.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Pakse (PKZ) tiene vuelos de Lao Airlines hacia y desde Guangzhou, Siem Reap y Ciudad Ho Chi Minh.
getting_in.quote: The third international airport, with Lao Airlines flights to/from Guangzhou, Siem Reap (Vientiane–Pakse–Siem Reap) and Ho Chi Minh City.

getting_in.en: The Kunming to Vientiane train takes 10 hr 30 min, and you must get off at Mohan and Boten to complete Chinese and Lao border formalities.
getting_in.es: El tren de Kunming a Vientiane tarda 10 h 30 min, y debes bajar en Mohan y Boten para los trámites fronterizos chinos y laosianos.
getting_in.quote: The train runs at speeds of up to 160 km/h, covering the distance from Kunming to Vientiane in 10 hr 30 min, though you will have to get off the train at Mohan and Boten to complete Chinese and Lao border formalities respectively.

getting_in.en: Direct overnight sleeper trains from Bangkok's Krung Thep Aphiwat station to Vientiane's Khamsavath station started in July 2024.
getting_in.es: Desde julio de 2024 hay trenes cama nocturnos directos de la estación Krung Thep Aphiwat de Bangkok a la estación Khamsavath de Vientiane.
getting_in.quote: Direct ovenight sleeper train services from Bangkok's Krung Thep Aphiwat station to the Vientiane's new, more centrally located Khamsavath station started in July 2024.

getting_in.en: There are eight border crossings open to all between Thailand and Laos.
getting_in.es: Hay ocho cruces fronterizos abiertos a todos entre Tailandia y Laos.
getting_in.quote: There are eight border crossings open to all between Thailand and Laos.

getting_around.en: The Lao-China Railway, opened in December 2021, runs from Boten through Muang Xay, Luang Prabang and Vang Vieng to Vientiane.
getting_around.es: El ferrocarril Laos-China, abierto en diciembre de 2021, va de Boten por Muang Xay, Luang Prabang y Vang Vieng hasta Vientiane.
getting_around.quote: The first railway in Laos, the Chinese-built Lao-China Railway crossing the northern half of the country from the Chinese border at Mohan/Boten via Muang Xay, Luang Prabang and Vang Vieng to Vientiane opened in December 2021.

getting_around.en: As of 2024, Vientiane-Luang Prabang flights (40 minutes) started at US$34, while the high-speed train costs US$12 and takes 2 hours.
getting_around.es: En 2024, los vuelos Vientiane-Luang Prabang (40 minutos) costaban desde US$34, y el tren de alta velocidad cuesta US$12 y tarda 2 horas.
getting_around.quote: tickets for the popular Vientiane-Luang Prabang route (40 minutes) can be had for as little as US$34 (Lao Skyway), but the new high-speed train connects these two places for only US$12, and takes 2 hours.

getting_around.en: The main ride-hailing app in Laos is Loca, and you can pay by cash or by credit card through the app.
getting_around.es: La principal app de transporte en Laos es Loca, y puedes pagar en efectivo o con tarjeta de crédito en la app.
getting_around.quote: The main ride-hailing app in Laos is Loca. You can pay by cash or use a credit card to pay through the Loca app.

getting_around.en: Local transport under 20 km uses tuk-tuks, jumbos and sky labs, and a jumbo should cost no more than 20,000 kip for 1-5 km.
getting_around.es: El transporte local de menos de 20 km usa tuk-tuks, jumbos y sky labs, y un jumbo no debería costar más de 20,000 kip por 1-5 km.
getting_around.quote: Local transport (less than 20 km) in Laos consists of tuk-tuks, jumbos, and sky labs, motorised three or four wheelers. A jumbo should cost no more than 20,000 kip for short journeys of 1-5 km.

getting_around.en: The text advises not to buy bus tickets online in Laos, as the information is incorrect or missing or prices are vastly inflated.
getting_around.es: El texto aconseja no comprar boletos de autobús en línea en Laos, porque la información es incorrecta o falta, o los precios están muy inflados.
getting_around.quote: A good rule for Laos is do not buy bus tickets online. The information is either incorrect, missing, or the prices are vastly inflated!

getting_around.en: Google Maps is described as not good for navigation in Laos because many roads are not shown.
getting_around.es: Se indica que Google Maps no es bueno para navegar en Laos porque faltan muchas carreteras.
getting_around.quote: Google Maps is not good for navigation in Laos. Many roads are not shown.

money.en: The currency of Laos is the kip (LAK).
money.es: La moneda de Laos es el kip (LAK).
money.quote: The Lao currency is the kip (ກີບ), pronounced kiip and officially denoted by the symbol "₭" (ISO code: LAK).

money.en: Foreign currencies, especially the US dollar, are commonly used for larger purchases.
money.es: Las divisas extranjeras, sobre todo el dólar estadounidense, se usan comúnmente para compras grandes.
money.quote: The only official currency of Laos is the kip, but foreign currencies, especially the US dollar, are commonly used for larger purchases.

money.en: BCEL is the largest bank in Laos and accepts Visa/Cirrus and MasterCard/Maestro.
money.es: BCEL es el banco más grande de Laos y acepta Visa/Cirrus y MasterCard/Maestro.
money.quote: BCEL is the largest bank in the country, accepts Visa/Cirrus and MasterCard/Maestro.

money.en: A few visitors were forced to leave early because they could not withdraw funds, so always bring some cash.
money.es: Algunos visitantes tuvieron que salir antes de tiempo por no poder retirar fondos, así que lleva siempre algo de efectivo.
money.quote: A few visitors have been forced out of the country prematurely as they couldn't withdraw funds to continue their travels. Always bring some cash.

money.en: In markets, bargaining is always expected.
money.es: En los mercados siempre se espera que regatees.
money.quote: In markets, bargaining is always expected. Do not lose your cool: just keep smiling.

money.en: Money changers will reject bills with even small marks and tears, so bring the newest notes you can.
money.es: Los cambistas rechazan billetes con pequeñas marcas o roturas, así que lleva los billetes más nuevos posibles.
money.quote: Try to bring the newest and shiniest notes you can, since money changers will reject bills that have even small marks and tears.

etiquette.en: Dress respectfully when visiting temples and take your shoes off before entering temple buildings and private houses.
etiquette.es: Vístete con respeto al visitar templos y quítate los zapatos antes de entrar a edificios de templos y casas privadas.
etiquette.quote: Dress respectfully (long trousers, sleeved shirts) when visiting temples and take your shoes off before entering temple buildings and private houses.

etiquette.en: Showing the soles of your feet is very poor manners, and you should never touch anyone on the head.
etiquette.es: Mostrar las plantas de los pies es de muy mala educación y nunca se debe tocar a nadie en la cabeza.
etiquette.quote: As with other Buddhist countries, showing the soles of your feet is very poor manners. Never touch any person on the head.

etiquette.en: Public drunkenness is considered disrespectful and a loss of face.
etiquette.es: La embriaguez en público se considera una falta de respeto y una pérdida de prestigio.
etiquette.quote: Despite the prevalence of cheap alcohol, public drunkenness is considered disrespectful and a loss of face.

etiquette.en: Things happen slowly in Laos, and Lao people will find humour in any tourist showing anger.
etiquette.es: Las cosas ocurren despacio en Laos, y a los laosianos les parecerá gracioso cualquier turista que muestre enojo.
etiquette.quote: Things in Laos happen slowly and rarely as scheduled. Keep your cool, as Lao people will find humour in any tourist showing anger.

etiquette.en: Women should not touch a monk, as monks are forbidden from touching women.
etiquette.es: Las mujeres no deben tocar a un monje, pues a los monjes les está prohibido tocar a las mujeres.
etiquette.quote: Do not touch a monk if you are a woman. Monks are forbidden from touching women.

etiquette.en: Criticising or insulting the government is punishable by up to five years in prison and a very hefty fine.
etiquette.es: Criticar o insultar al gobierno se castiga con hasta cinco años de cárcel y una multa muy elevada.
etiquette.quote: Do not criticise, insult, or show any kind of disrespect to the government; this is punishable by up to five years in prison and a very hefty fine.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards can be bought without paperwork in various shops, including at Vientiane airport.
connectivity.es: Se pueden comprar SIM de prepago sin papeleo en varias tiendas, incluido el aeropuerto de Vientiane.
connectivity.quote: Local prepaid SIM cards can be purchased in various shops and stores, including at the airport in Vientiane (walk through to the Domestic Terminal to find a shop selling snacks and Unitel SIMs), without any paperwork.

connectivity.en: Most accommodations, even budget places in Vientiane, offer free Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de los alojamientos, incluso los económicos en Vientiane, ofrecen wifi gratis.
connectivity.quote: Most accommodations, even budget places in Vientiane, offer free Wi-Fi.

connectivity.en: Since 2022, travellers can order a Laos tourist SIM card before their trip and have it delivered to their accommodation in Vientiane.
connectivity.es: Desde 2022 los viajeros pueden pedir una SIM turística de Laos antes del viaje y recibirla en su alojamiento en Vientiane.
connectivity.quote: Since 2022, travellers can order a Laos tourist SIM card prior to their trip and get it delivered to their accommodation in Vientiane.

connectivity.en: ETL Mobile is known to have better coverage in rural and remote parts of Laos.
connectivity.es: Se sabe que ETL Mobile tiene mejor cobertura en zonas rurales y remotas de Laos.
connectivity.quote: ETL Mobile is known to have better coverage in rural and remote parts of Laos.

connectivity.en: There is Thai network coverage close to the Thai border, and Thai SIM and top-up cards can be bought in Laos.
connectivity.es: Hay cobertura tailandesa cerca de la frontera con Tailandia, y en Laos se pueden comprar SIM y tarjetas de recarga tailandesas.
connectivity.quote: there is Thai coverage close to the Thai border (including a significant part of Vientiane), and Thai SIM cards and top-up cards can be bought in Laos

connectivity.en: Without a Laos SIM you cannot sign up for the useful Laos apps that require a Laos phone number.
connectivity.es: Sin una SIM de Laos no puedes registrarte en las apps útiles de Laos que requieren un número telefónico laosiano.
connectivity.quote: if you do not have a Laos SIM, then you cannot sign up for the useful Laos apps that require a Laos phone number.
